purpose: Reusable agent contract for human-first brand, content, visual, image, and HTML-demo generation.

scanability_contract.heading_rule: Use descriptive headings that tell the reader what they will learn or gain.
scanability_contract.bolding_rule: Use one short meaningful anchor when helpful, usually 2–8 words, for a problem, outcome, mechanism, proof, or boundary.
scanability_contract.scan_test: Read only headings, bold phrases, and link text; they should communicate the problem, promise, mechanism, boundary, and next action.
scanability_contract.accessibility_rule: Keep the text understandable when bold styling disappears and use semantic headings for structure.
